question: HbA1c is 9.2% on Metformin + Glimepiride, eGFR is 38. How should I transition this patient to insulin safely?

flags.action: STOP - switch to insulin or Linagliptin
flags.detail: Sulfonylureas accumulate in renal impairment causing prolonged hypoglycemia. RSSDI 2022: STOP sulfonylurea when eGFR <30; use insulin or Linagliptin (no renal adjustment needed).
flags.title: Glimepiride in CKD (eGFR 31): high hypoglycemia risk

flags.action: Avoid alcohol. If consumed, eat carbs, monitor glucose.
flags.detail: Severe hypoglycemia, disulfiram-like reaction. Mechanism: Additive hypoglycemic effect; alcohol impairs gluconeogenesis.
flags.title: Glimepiride + Alcohol: SEVERE

flags.action: Hold metformin 48h before and after IV contrast if eGFR <60.
flags.detail: Lactic acidosis. Mechanism: Risk of contrast-induced AKI → metformin accumulation → lactic acidosis.
flags.title: Metformin + IV contrast dye: SEVERE

flags.action: Avoid or hold statin during macrolide course. Use azithromycin instead.
flags.detail: Myopathy, rhabdomyolysis. Mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition → increased statin levels.
flags.title: Atorvastatin + Erythromycin / Clarithromycin: SEVERE

flags.action: Limit alcohol. Avoid binge drinking. Patient education.
flags.detail: Lactic acidosis, hypoglycemia. Mechanism: Increased lactic acidosis risk; impairs gluconeogenesis.
flags.title: Metformin + Alcohol: MODERATE

flags.action: Avoid concurrent use. If NSAID needed, take aspirin 2h before NSAID.
flags.detail: Reduced cardioprotection + dual GI bleeding risk. Mechanism: NSAID blocks aspirin's antiplatelet effect (competitive COX-1 binding).
flags.title: Aspirin + Ibuprofen / Diclofenac (NSAIDs): MODERATE

flags.action: Increase antidiabetic doses during steroid course. Monitor glucose.
flags.detail: Loss of glycemic control. Mechanism: Steroids cause hyperglycemia.
flags.title: Metformin + Prednisolone / Steroids: MODERATE

flags.action: Limit alcohol. Use PPI if needed.
flags.detail: GI bleeding risk. Mechanism: Both irritate gastric mucosa.
flags.title: Aspirin + Alcohol: MODERATE

flags.detail: Dapagliflozin (DAPA-CKD) provides renoprotection at eGFR ≥25. ACEi/ARB mandatory if albuminuria.
flags.title: Consider SGLT2 inhibitor for diabetic kidney disease
